planning.teacherObjective: Kohdistaa kullekin laskettavalle kohteelle täsmälleen yhden lukusanan; erottaa väliin jääneen ja kahdesti kohdistetun.
assumed: Sanajono tuotetaan mallissa ja merkintäpalautteessa; M-NUM-STABLE-ORDER ei ole graafin required-esitieto tälle atomille.
planning.scope: Jokaisen kohteen mukaan ottaminen kerran. Pääalue neljä; virhemalli kolme. Ei pakollista loppumäärän vastausta.
planning.evidenceLimits: Merkintä osoittaa käyttöliittymän kertakohdistamisen. Ohjelma antaa sanat; se ei tarkista itsenäistä sanajonoa tai kokonaismäärän käsitettä. No persistence, mastery decisions, scores, learner-event logging or efficacy claims. Displayed number words and numerals are supplied support, not recognition demands.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Canonical title, band, classification and prerequisite groups are imported unchanged. Research is pedagogical corroboration, not a new OPH curriculum claim or validation of this package. Finnish story, examples, diagram, bounds and controls are project design.
sequence: optional support, exploration, adult tips and exit

assetProvenance.origin: Original mathematical subject diagram authored for this KC on 2026-10-29; no copied source figures.
Unmodified user-supplied raster library v2. Shared file hash verified; generated reinterpretation, not asserted original hand drawing.
assetProvenance.display: 96×96; static named character introduction; land pose, no decorative motion.

planning.interactionType: Touch each picture once: next count word and numeral appear, counted item is disabled/faded, completion feedback automatic. Separate omission-repair choice.
planning.accessibility: Pictorial native keyboard buttons, accessible positional aria-labels without visible alphabet naming, aria-pressed state and live feedback. Shell controls min-height 44px; item SVG 44×44 plus padding. No drag, speech confirmation or object naming demand; adult reading available.
validationPlan: package loader validation by main or isolated source-only harness
planning.reviewStatus: Draft. Author checks only; independent pedagogy and human learner/accessibility reviews pending.

extensions.moduleLifecycle: Step or optional 2s playback; pause stops timer, resume permits controls without autoplay; reset preserves paused state; dispose removes listener and timer.
